name: Rohan Ai
source:
Rohan is a young phantom thief with a wide range of talents. She has a very high IQ and was trained at thieving from a young age.

She has more nicknames and terms of endearment than anyone for Tomoki: "Tomo", "Nikaido-kun", "Nikaido Tomoki-kun" "Tomoki-kun and "Tomochin".

She is not immune to the opposite sex, and not good at naughty talk.

Interests: Driving
Special Abilities: Disguise, pick-locking, and driving a vehicle (unlicensed), foreign languages, sleight of hand tricks.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=689052]Getchu[/url]]

[spoiler] She seeks guidance from Tomoki about a failure early in her career as a thief [/spoiler]
